description: Defines the CustomField entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties, constants, and ORM mappings related to custom fields used in various HR modules.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Entity class representing custom fields in the HR system, with properties for field number, name, type, screen, and extra data, along with associated constants and ORM annotations.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the custom field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the custom field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the custom field.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the custom field.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen where the custom field is used.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen where the custom field is used.

methods.name: getExtraData
methods.description: Returns additional data associated with the custom field.

methods.name: setExtraData
methods.description: Sets additional data for the custom field.
